entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Feels pretty great having[n]everyone talk about us, huh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Madarame is the only topic of[n]conversation at my school.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And as I'm his pupil, most of my[n]peers have chosen to ignore me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you going to be OK?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There is no need to worry.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They had already been[n]treating me differently[n]from others as it stood.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is nothing new to me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: More importantly, do we have any[n]leads on our next mission?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You kidding? There's no way we'd[n]find a target that quick!
We need to wait and see.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oooh, we could always go[n]to Mementos instead!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will keep myself free. Please[n]tell me if anything comes up.
